parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Plasma cells can be used in the commercial production of some monoclonal antibodies.
The method of production is known as the hybridoma method.
Outline the steps in the production of monoclonal antibodies by the hybridoma method.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Antibodies can be collected from human blood donors and used to treat people that may have been infected with a pathogen. This prevents them becoming ill with the disease.
Explain why this treatment does not prevent people becoming ill if they are infected again with the same pathogen.
